name: Mohawk Mark

skins.name: Napkin
skins.lore: Hoodvincible, one of the most recognizable evil Invincible variants from the Invincible War. He is remembered for his hooded appearance and ruthless personality.

skins.name: Lensless
skins.lore: Nogogglecible, an alternate Invincible variant recognizable for fighting without the goggles normally attached to the Invincible mask.

skins.name: Viltrumite
skins.lore: Viltumincible, an alternate Mark Grayson fully loyal to the Viltrum Empire who embraced conquest and destruction instead of becoming Earth's hero.

skins.name: Prisoner
skins.lore: Prisonincible, an Invincible variant shown restrained and imprisoned following the destruction caused during the Invincible War.

skins.name: Sinister
skins.lore: Sinister Mark, one of the most dangerous and violent Invincible variants. Unlike many others, he survived the Invincible War and later became a recurring threat in the comics.

skins.name: Fully Masked
skins.lore: Maskvincible, an alternate Invincible variant known for fully covering his face and for his emotional attachment to his mother compared to the other brutal variants.

skins.name: Omni-Mark
skins.lore: Omni-Mark, an alternate Mark Grayson who followed Omni-Man completely, wearing a suit inspired by his father's design and embracing the Viltrumite mission of planetary conquest.

skins.name: Bug Eyed
skins.lore: Also called Goggles Mark, an alternate Invincible variant recognized for his oversized goggles and insect-like appearance.

lore: The Invincible variants are alternate versions of Mark Grayson from the Invincible comic and animated series. Across different universes and timelines, these variants developed unique appearances and personalities while sharing the same Viltrumite heritage, super strength, flight, and brutal fighting abilities.
